purpose: Teach: 儲かっ/聴ける/リタイア/小雨/平ら/殴っ/呑ん/止めよ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんのお仕事が儲かったみたいよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad's work has been going well lately.
lines.style: Soft observation, like sharing something she's noticed and wants him to know. Warm, unhurried. A quiet smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと一緒に音楽が聴けるの嬉しいよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I'm really happy I get to listen to music with Dad now.
lines.style: Bright, genuine excitement. Quick pace at the start, then settling into sincere warmth. The kind of honest joy a 6-year-old voices without filter.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖父ちゃんがリタイアされて家にいらっしゃるわ
lines.en: Sho, your grandfather has retired and he's home now.
lines.style: Gentle information, delivered with care. Noticing how this might land with him. Steady, attentive tone. Not a question, but leaving space for his response.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、小雨の日でも公園に行きたいよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I want to go to the park even on rainy days.
lines.style: Earnest request with quiet determination. Small voice but steady. Not demanding—offering an idea he's thought about. Slight lift at the end.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが砂場を平らにして下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad leveled out the sandbox for you.
lines.style: A small piece of care, noticed and shared. Tender acknowledgment. Quiet pride in the gentleness of the gesture. Slow, warm delivery.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、絶対誰も殴ったりしないよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I promise I'll never hit anyone.
lines.style: Solemn, firm with the seriousness only a 6-year-old can carry. Direct eye contact in the voice. Not defensive—making a vow he believes matters.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがお薬を呑んでお休みになったわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad took his medicine and he's resting now.
lines.style: Quiet reassurance underneath. Matter-of-fact but tender. The slight weight of care that comes from checking on someone. Measured, calm pace.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お菓子の食べ過ぎは止めようと思うよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I've decided I'm going to stop eating too many snacks.
lines.style: Proud announcement of a small decision. Earnest, determined. The voice of someone who's thought about this and wants her to know he's trying. Warm close.
